assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the terrain to change. Replace EVERY tree, rock, flower, grass blade-clump, bush, earth path, stepping stone and pond with the surrounding clean green grass surface. The result must be ONLY a wide full-bleed 16:9 meadow ground texture with NO recognizable objects anywhere. Preserve the reference's muted lush medium meadow green palette; 90 percent quiet flat color with just a few very broad subtly lighter/darker soft irregular green areas. No speckles, leaf shapes, tiny strokes, noise, objects, tree shadows, trails, rocks, water, outlines, border, horizon, text or watermark. Same high overhead flat ground view. This is a reusable clean substrate underneath individually placeable props, NOT an illustrated map. Completely opaque.

Use case: stylized-concept. Input image 1 is STYLE, PALETTE AND CAMERA REFERENCE ONLY. Create an original modular 2D game environment asset matching that reference's clean commercial chibi RPG art: high overhead orthographic oblique 60-65 degrees above the ground, no horizon, dark blue-green clear outlines, 2-3 restrained cel shade colors per material, sunlight from upper left. Smooth non-pixel art, no realism, no glossy 3D, no painterly texture, no text or watermark. Exactly ONE standalone asset centered, complete and uncropped with modest transparent padding. Real alpha transparent background. No ground plane, no cast shadow, no decorative extras: each prop must be freely placeable independently in Unity. Subject: ONE complete rounded pink cherry-blossom tree. Puffy overlapping canopy masses with the same pink palette and restrained dark mauve shaded undersides as the reference; compact chunky trunk and only a few exposed roots, visible from high above. Entire broad canopy and trunk inside frame, NOT cropped. Readable simplified petal clusters, no hundreds of tiny flower lines. No grass, ground, fallen petals, rocks or attached decorations. The trunk touches a single ground contact point near bottom center; no shadow on transparent padding.
